description: Changelog for Inception Maze Game - AI-powered maze building and solving platform

changes.description: Implement FastAPI backend with SQLAlchemy async ORM, PostgreSQL database models (User, Maze, Attempt, Event, ApiCall) with full traceability
Add Clerk JWT authentication with user creation/management and secure API key storage per user
Create OpenRouter service with model fetching, tool-capable filtering, and free model detection
Implement SSE-based maze solving with event streaming, tool execution, and real-time agent position updates
Add comprehensive monitoring API with API call tracking, cost aggregation, and period-based filtering (day/week/month)
Create predefined challenges service with model-specific time-constrained maze challenges
Build React frontend with React Router for 4-page navigation (Challenges, Builder, MyMazes, Settings)
Integrate Clerk authentication with protected routes and user session management
Implement interactive maze canvas with dot-based wall drawing, smooth interpolation, and hover preview
Create Challenges page with challenge cards showing model, time limit, grid size, and difficulty
Build Maze Builder page with model selection, real-time agent visualization, and solve logs
Implement My Mazes page with saved maze list, attempt history table, and success/failure indicators
Create Settings page with API key management, usage monitoring dashboard, and account/logout controls
Set up Docker Compose with PostgreSQL 16 for local development
Configure GitHub Actions CI workflow with Python lint (ruff), pytest, and frontend build/test
Add backend unit and integration tests for maze logic, wall coordinates, tool execution, and challenges
Create frontend Vitest tests for Maze class operations and CONFIG validation
Add CODEOWNERS file with Antonio7098 as codeowner for all files
Fix has_wall_between function to correctly calculate wall keys using max() instead of min() for proper collision detection
Fix agent/start/end rendering to use cell center coordinates (x+0.5, y+0.5) instead of dot positions
Fix canvas sizing to use (gridSize+1)*cellSize for proper dot fitting and add padding for visual alignment
Fix wall drawing interpolation to properly handle fast mouse movements with step-based path interpolation
Add MazeBench leaderboard service with geometric mean scoring for normalized LLM comparison across mazes
Implement medal system: Gold (±10%), Silver (±15%), Bronze (±20%) based on best time per maze
Add MazeStats and MazeBenchEntry database models for tracking per-maze statistics and model rankings
Add API endpoints: GET /api/mazebench, GET /api/challenges/{id}/solutions, GET /api/mazes/{id}/stats
Add challenge_id and medal columns to Attempt model for tracking challenge completions and achievements
Create MazeBench leaderboard page showing global LLM rankings with score, solve count, and medal tallies
Add expandable solutions panel to Challenges page showing past successful attempts with medals
Display medals in MyMazes attempts table for completed solves
Add MazeBench navigation link to main nav bar
